opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding quality teaching; institutions only; not for individual students.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions (not university departments) that can demonstrate outstanding teaching; institutions only.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries for undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution up to £56,000 year 1 and £28,000 years 2‑3; research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with a doctorate, not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers living in the UK, former UK university staff.
opportunities.summary: Supports completion of a research project after retirement.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million to UK universities

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to 30 doctoral scholarships and related funding in interdisciplinary priority areas.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with Office for Students) with research degree awarding powers; can be single or collaborative.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale research centres of up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Research expenses up to £6,000 per year; salary costs covered

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at an eligible UK university.
opportunities.summary: Supports distinguished researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with international impact, holding a permanent post or long‑term fellowship; doctorate awarded ≤10 years ago.
opportunities.summary: Provides £100,000 to support any research purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers whose teaching/administrative duties have limited research time.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment.
opportunities.summary: Supports building a modest research team and leadership development.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university host institution; applicant must be UK academic staff coordinating the visit.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits by eminent overseas professors to enhance skills and knowledge in the UK.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other higher‑education institutions, and trial UK independent research institutes.
opportunities.summary: Supports innovative research projects up to five years.
